profile.headline: Information Systems Engineering Student | Software Development & Cybersecurity
profile.bio: Final-year Information Systems Engineering student pivoting into cybersecurity, with the BASE4 Security Cybersecurity Foundations Bootcamp completed and hands-on experience building and deploying backend systems in the health sector. Argentine & Italian citizen (EU work authorization). Spanish native, English C1 (Cambridge First Certificate). Currently seeking new opportunities.

projects.title: Syscow
projects.summary: Livestock management platform: Rails 8 API with JWT auth and a Next.js frontend.
projects.description: A system for managing cattle operations: animals, lots, fields, breeds, vaccinations, treatments, and weight/feed records. Backend built with Ruby on Rails 8, Devise + JWT auth, and policy-based authorization (Pundit); frontend in Next.js consuming the API. Deployed on a self-managed VPS behind Traefik, with automatic HTTPS via Let's Encrypt.

projects.title: Car price estimator pipeline
projects.summary: Data pipeline built with Apache Airflow to estimate used car prices.
projects.description: Capstone project at UTN (team of 3): an Airflow-orchestrated pipeline that processes and models used car data to estimate market price. Built collaboratively applying data engineering best practices.

projects.title: Administrative management system
projects.summary: Ruby on Rails app for managing appointments and administrative processes.
projects.description: Personal project (2025): a Ruby on Rails web application for managing appointments and administrative processes, applying object-oriented programming, MVC architecture, and a frontend built with HTML, CSS, JavaScript and TypeScript.

projects.title: Keramike
projects.summary: Website deployed on a self-managed VPS with Docker and automatic certificates.
projects.description: Site for keramikee.com, deployed on self-managed infrastructure (Hostinger VPS) with Docker and Traefik as a reverse proxy, with automatic TLS certificate renewal via Let's Encrypt.

experience.description: Supervised Professional Practice (PPS). Designed and built Whalma, an intelligent WhatsApp chatbot for member services using n8n, Python, PostgreSQL and LLM APIs (OpenAI Platform). Deployed services in Docker containers and managed PostgreSQL data storage and integrations. Developed a Flask web admin panel to monitor chatbot conversations, diagnosing and resolving Python 3.13 / psycopg2 dependency compatibility issues. Collaborated on automation and optimization projects focused on operational efficiency.

Developed and maintained web applications using JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Python, HTML and CSS. Managed code with Git and GitHub within agile teams following SCRUM and Kanban. Worked with multidisciplinary teams to improve delivery efficiency on collaborative projects.
